item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:00 PM 26 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Marinduque(Gasan, Mogpog), #OrientalMindoro(Baco, Bongabong), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Garchitorena, Presentacion, Bato), #Albay(Oas), #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos, Catubig, Pambujan), #Catanduanes(SanMiguel and Gigmoto) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Naujan, Victoria, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bansud), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres, Viga, Panganiban), #Marinduque(Boac), #NorthernSamar(LasNavas) and #Albay(Libon) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
